logo_override.validation_detail: PNG probed: webfetch returned 'Image fetched successfully' (HTTP 200, image content type); rendered as navy 'Yale University' wordmark on light/transparent background, not white-on-transparent
logo_override._award: Verified official Yale University wordmark asset served from www.yale.edu (same registrable domain yale.edu as shard host admissions.yale.edu); URL probed, not guessed

notes: admissions.yale.edu (Drupal 10 / Atomic theme) ships no logo image file in markup: the 'Yale University' branding link in the header is plain text linking to https://www.yale.edu, and only favicon assets are declared (Babs-WebIcon_transparent.png - the Undergraduate Admissions sub-brand icon, not the University logo). Fell back to the official Yale University homepage www.yale.edu, whose Site Logo markup references /sites/all/themes/yale_blue/images/logo-print.png. Probed that URL directly: image bytes returned, renders the navy 'Yale University' wordmark. Host is www.yale.edu, same registrable domain as admissions.yale.edu, so it is an in-domain official asset. brand.yale.edu did not resolve (transport error), so no separate brand/brandguide logo page was available. On-screen masthead logo is a CSS background on .logo_main.icon_only with no separately fetchable file; logo-print.png is the fetchable official wordmark. Applies to target 126 (Yale College need-based aid page).
